purpose: Offline retrieval and preservation of evidence from real exported conversations; no LLM answer quality measurement

task_authoring.query: researcher-authored paraphrase, not authentic new user utterance
task_authoring.pass_2: interpretation review by another agent in the same session; not independent adjudication
task_authoring.researcher_exposure: all benchmark families read for task construction; no independent or blind validation claim
task_authoring.selection_bias: purposive availability sample drawn from previously selected 12-family panel; not archive-wide population estimate
task_authoring.query_distribution_limitation: Queries deliberately reference known conversation topics and often share distinctive vocabulary with evidence. This is not a natural independent query distribution.

candidate_policy.unit: whole exported message with all preserved literal text fields
candidate_policy.default: entire family, identical for all methods
candidate_policy.prefix_exceptions: two unresolved-conflict tasks use explicitly listed messages through an observed boundary before subsequent resolution; later messages are unavailable to every method
candidate_policy.native_relations: only preserved parent/child edges; no inferred semantic relation
candidate_policy.oversize: skip whole message if it cannot fit budget; record missing evidence; never silently truncate
candidate_policy.token_counts: only when an identified versioned local tokenizer is available; otherwise null, never bytes divided by a heuristic
candidate_policy.branch_coverage: One task tests an actual native sibling; one retrieves an instruction to transfer a side topic, which is not treated as native branch navigation.

evidence_policy.expected_evidence: Essential direct source messages. evidence_sets lists alternative sufficient sets; retain every message in any one set. expected_evidence is their union and required=false denotes alternatives, not waived evidence.
evidence_policy.source_attribution: user claims, assistant proposals, and quoted external text remain distinguished
evidence_policy.answers: admissible_answer describes evidence content without certifying factual allegations or advice
evidence_policy.forbidden_evidence: Annotated wrong-version/branch distractors for this query. Selection/inclusion is reported separately; selecting old and new together does not prove a model followed the wrong instruction.
evidence_policy.absence: two bounded absence tasks have zero positive evidence, explicit absence-support pointers and full-family reviewed scope; retrieving no record is abstention, not semantic proof that answer is absent
evidence_policy.graph: native structural traversal measures navigation, never semantic understanding

evaluation.paired: same task and same candidate pool under each budget
evaluation.aggregation: per-task output and paired within-family averages; family-level summaries and uncertainty with explicit n=12/8/4
evaluation.missing: undefined metrics remain null; absent-answer cases excluded from positive recall/ranking denominator and reported separately
evaluation.tuning: all method settings frozen before results; any later tuning must use tuning families only and have a new frozen revision
evaluation.no_winner_policy: no automatic preset adoption or universal winner claim

precision_denominators.precision_at_k: relevant selected count divided by fixed k; shorter byte-constrained returns incur empty ranks
precision_denominators.selected_record_precision: relevant selected count divided by actual selected records; undefined when empty
precision_denominators.recall: best covered fraction among alternative sufficient evidence sets
